camel_example: aliyun esa CreateCustomHostname --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890123 --PrivateKey '-----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --Hostname 'custom.site.com' --CertType free --RecordId 1234567890123 --SslFlag on --CasId 30000478 --CasRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --Certificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----'
description_en: Creates a SaaS domain name for a site
description_zh: 在站点下创建一个 SaaS 域名
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-custom-hostname --hostname custom.site.com --site-id 1234567890123 --record-id 1234567890123 --ssl-flag on --cert-type free --certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE----- --biz-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY----- --cas-id 30000478 --cas-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomHostname

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the record to bind. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html operation to obtain the record ID
parameters.help_zh: 待绑定记录的ID，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html获取
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL. Valid values:
on: Enable SSL.
off: Disable SSL
parameters.help_zh:
SSL开关。
on: 开启 SSL。
off: 关闭 SSL
parameters.name: ssl_flag

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on. Valid values:
free: free certificate.
upload: uploaded certificate.
cas: SSL Certificates Service certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型，SslFlag 为 on 时需要输入该参数。
free: 免费证书。
upload: 上传证书。
cas: 云盾证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The certificate content. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书内容，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.help_en: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书私钥，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en: The SSL Certificates Service certificate ID. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas
parameters.help_zh: 云盾证书ID，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: cas_id

parameters.help_en:
The region of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.
For Chinese site accounts, set this parameter to cn-hangzhou.
For International site accounts, set this parameter to ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh:
云盾证书地域，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数。
中国站账号传参数值：cn-hangzhou。
国际站账号传参数值：ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cas_region
